issue: M1: Qwen2.5-14B BR=3.85 has no artifact support; only appeared in Reviewer notes

old_value.source: No JSON artifact. Value found only in Reviewer notes.
old_value.likely_origin: Possibly computed on SC-wrong questions (n=49) instead of SICA-wrong (n=52)

new_value.method: mean of per-question gold_frac, then BR = (1-mean)/mean

rationale: br_bootstrap_ci.json is the canonical artifact for raw BR values, used consistently for Mistral (4.97, n=83). Same method applied to Qwen gives 3.93 (n=52 SICA-wrong questions). The n_questions difference (52 SICA-wrong vs 49 SC-wrong) explains the value discrepancy: 3.85 was likely an ad-hoc computation on a different question set.

cross_check.note: n_err=49 is SC errors (204*0.2402=49). BR is computed on n=52 SICA-wrong questions. These are different metrics in different columns — no inconsistency.
